text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Greek Cypriot press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind accuses Greece and Turkey of lacking the political will to find a peaceful solution to the Cyprus problem.
- Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash blasts 'biased' U.N. report on alleged shooting incident near Louroujina last week.
- The decision to liberalize foreign investments is one of despair, says member of parliament Mr. Kikis Kazamias.
- Meetings and contacts between parties for nominating candidates for the 1998 presidential elections.
